name: Algebraic Vector Span Isomorphism
description: Transforms the graph connectivity requirement into an equivalent linear algebra requirement: spanning the difference vectors of target dimensions using a subset of allowed basis difference vectors. This hides the graph structure entirely while preserving the exact mathematical solution space via the properties of graphic matroids and totally unimodular matrices. The models will struggle to recognize the Steiner Tree problem without graph-theoretic or set-partitioning cues.
